prompt: The bots join the Meta Global AI Hackathon and win!
title: Hackathon, Hackathon!
irony: A one-line cartoon meant to build itself ends up singing the long nights its builders spent building it.
facts: The Meta Global AI Hackathon is ten days, online, with builders worldwide (dev.meta.ai).
It opens with a kickoff livestream plus workshops from Meta and partners (dev.meta.ai).
Projects are due Nov 4, judging runs Nov 4-8, winners are named at the Nov 9 closing show (fact sheet).
The Indie track judges creativity, technical ambition, and whether it works (dev.meta.ai).
The win is a name called at the closing show, with no trophy or medal (fact sheet).
Musical Bots turns one typed line into a sung 3D cartoon with live synthesized voices (README.md).
Muse Code directs seven crew bots covering lyrics, chords, dance, lights, deals, hype, comedy (README.md).
The singer learned twenty thousand words after toy box and hackathon sang as mush (git log).
Hands meet on the beat now, after the high-five whiffed and grabs missed (git log).
The crew finished days before the Nov 4 deadline and waited for the show (git log).

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Night on the street: a laptop glows, sixteen heads gather round one typed cartoon line.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: In the big house Green reads Meta's hackathon rules aloud and picks the Indie track, checking every line twice.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: The bots sing first, but the toy box blurs and hackathon twists, while the Nov 4 clock ticks.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: On the diner stage the crew chants the hook, types one line and presses Premiere together.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Green feeds lines to the rhyme gate, it stamps no again and again, then the high-five whiffs.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: The camera films clouds, the lamp burns the walls white, the choir drowns the words, two songs clash.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: Back on the diner stage the crew chants the hook, taps the phone, the newest song wins.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Late at night two heads bump, Gold stops all and sets the step-right rule for all.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gold decides they ship what works, fix one bug at a time, and finish before Nov 4.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: On the diner stage Gold turns the hook, naming Musical Bots as the song they built.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: At the closing show judges press Premiere, the bots sing, the host calls Musical Bots, laptop glow.
